speaker: Kronii
message:
Anyways it was super nice seeing you guys! Thanks for stopping by!
    I'll try and have next week's schedule up by the end of today.
    I'm thinking tomorrow I'll do some superchat reading, hopefully
    I can get through all the superchats from the last 3000 years.
    Shouldn't take too long... hopefully.

speaker: Chat
message:
Isn't tomorrow your birthday? Are you going to do
    anything special?

speaker: Kronii
message:
Birthday? Oh, crap. I almost forgot.
    I guess being the warden of time does that to you sometimes. Hmm..
    Maybe I'll do a birthday zatsu, or sit in VC do wait for call-ins.

speaker: Chat
message: Call-ins? Who's gonna call? You're the last member of Hololive.

speaker: Kronii
message:
Last member of Hololive?! What? No! That's ridiculous!
    I'll just call Irys, she's always down for call-in.
    ... Huh?
    She graduated 300,000 years ago? She went to save humanity
    from intergalactic space pirates? Oh... yeah.
    I guess I do remember that. Well what about Florpus Melodica,
    From Hololive Outer-Space, generation 3876?
    ... She got sucked into a black hole and transported to an
    alternate dimension? Ah, right. I forgot about that too.
    Well, what about Bae?! I could always ask her!
    ... She's Australian? Shit. You're right.
    Dang, am I really the only left in Hololive?
    How long has it been? ... One million years?!
    Oh man, I really need to touch some grass.
    Ah... Sorry guys, there's just some things on my mind now.
    I think this week's schedule might be delayed for a bit.
    Anyways, Kroyasumii everyone! I'll see you next time.
